request.style: English, male baritone, soulful, piano, upright bass, brushed drums, saxophone, mellow jazz, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Seventy souls went down to the Nile
Gad's sons walked in a single file
Ziphion, Haggi, and Shuni too
Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, Areli's view
Jacob's household, sixty-six count
Two sons born in the new ground
Seventy total, safe and sound
In the land where the wheat is found

[Pre-Chorus]
Wilderness years, the census calls
Clans of Gad, standing in the halls
From Zephon to the Zephonite name
Shuni's line, none lost from fame

[Chorus]
Shunite clan, east of the Jordan stream
Livestock heavy, the quiet dream
Your inheritance lies on the other side
With the Reubenites, proudly pride

[Verse]
Moses spoke of the fathers' sin
Kadesh Barnea, the wandering spin
Forty years in the desert heat
But your flocks are a powerful feat
Build pens for the sheep and the goat
Cities for the children, afloat
We will arm ourselves for the fight
March ahead in the morning light

[Chorus]
Shunite clan, east of the Jordan stream
Livestock heavy, the quiet dream
Your inheritance lies on the other side
With the Reubenites, proudly pride

[Bridge]
Until the land is subdued before
The enemies gone, the wars no more
Then you may return, free of debt
To the Lord and to Israel, set

[Verse]
Sihon's kingdom, Og's Bashan land
Moses gave it, in his hand
Gad and Reuben, side by side
With half of Manasseh, they abide
The whole territory, city to city
A possession, a holy pity
No longer crossing, but staying true
In the east, in the ancient view

[Chorus]
Shunite clan, east of the Jordan stream
Livestock heavy, the quiet dream
Your inheritance lies on the other side
With the Reubenites, proudly pride

[Outro]
Shuni's name, in the book it remains
A thread in the lineage, through the rains
East of the river, the land is yours
In the promise, in the silent hours
